plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: if [ -n "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then [ "$EXPECTED_VERSION" = "${nextRelease.version}" ] || { echo "built $EXPECTED_VERSION but would release ${nextRelease.version}" >&2; exit 1; }; elif [ -n "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ]; then echo "version=${nextRelease.version}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

The `hush` CLI for macOS and Linux (arm64, x86_64): `brew install maxgfr/tap/hush`, or download the binary for your platform. The Android app: `hush-android.apk` (open it on the phone to install). Check any file against SHA256SUMS. The web app is at https://maxgfr.github.io/hush/.
